##: Desktop client of QwenWork (千问办公), the DingTalk AI office assistant served from qwenwork.cn.

The download page only ever links the stable .../release/latest/ path: the filename carries no version and versioned paths (release/<version>/...) return 404, so the download URL is constant across releases.

The vendor publishes no machine-readable release metadata. Unlike the electron-updater apps in this bucket there is no latest.yml under .../release/latest/ (nor a blockmap, version.json or .sha256), and the in-app updater at https://clientupgrade.qwenwork.cn/upgrade/query only answers authenticated POSTs (a bare GET 302s to the homepage), so no endpoint yields a version string.

checkver therefore range-reads the first 4 MiB of the installer and decodes the UTF-16 resource strings. The PE version resource sits inside that prefix (resource section at RVA 0x293000, 54 KiB), and its FileVersion string is the build stamp (2.1.0.26111315 for the 2026-11-13 build). The 3-part ProductVersion (2.1.0) is deliberately not used: the vendor re-uploads the same 3-part release with a new build stamp, and a 3-part version would miss those rebuilds.

No checksum is published either, and the OSS ETag is a multipart MD5, so autoupdate.hash is deliberately absent: when the build stamp moves, Excavator downloads the 402 MiB installer once and hashes it locally.

The installer is an NSIS-3 Unicode 32-bit stub around $PLUGINSDIR\app-64.7z; the installer script expands that inner archive into $dir and drops the NSIS leftovers ($PLUGINSDIR, the $R6 data blocks, 'Uninstall QwenWorkCN.exe' and uninstallerIcon.ico). The unpacked layout is flat, with QwenWorkCN.exe at the root.

Only the x64 build is packaged. The arm64 installer at the same path still served the 2026-11-10 payload while x64 had already moved to the 2026-11-13 one, and a single manifest cannot give the two architectures different versions.
description: AI office assistant for documents, slides, spreadsheets and web deliverables (千问办公)
notes: The NSIS stubs are dropped, so Scoop owns the uninstall.
Sign-in state, the profile data and the agent runtime are written to "$env:APPDATA\QwenWorkCN", so nothing needs to be persisted.

The bundled updater stays enabled. An in-app update runs the vendor installer, which installs a per-user copy outside the Scoop app directory instead of replacing it; run 'scoop install qwenwork-cn -f' afterwards to return to the packaged build.
The 402 MiB download unpacks to roughly 1.5 GiB in 7320 files, most of it the bundled agent runtimes, skills and Electron payload.
